name: @gcu/sw
description: The GCU service worker, extracted from the Auditable Works SW (ep → weir → works lineage): a generator (makeSw(config) → self-contained classic-script sw.js) over a route-table engine — stale-while-revalidate shell with ETag/byte-diff update detection, network-first, cache-first with maxEntries, passthrough (+ Static Routing API enhancement) — plus a page-side companion (registerGcuSw) wrapping the gcu-sw:* protocol: update toast, coordinated multi-tab reload, check-now, status, and the nuke repair hatch. The SW stays event-driven; cadence lives page-side.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
